verdict.rationale: Bento's closest feature is the signal: you describe a failure mode in plain English, and Bento trains a signal on your traces, fires it in real time and backfills history (bentolabs-docs-4). Each signal has an editable prompt and config (bentolabs-docs-36), and releases are scored against production history offline, in CI and on live traffic (bentolabs-docs-14). However, nothing explicitly says these are LLM-as-a-judge evaluators producing scores on outputs; signals are described as trained detectors that fire, not graded scorers. Missing for 10: explicit LLM-as-a-judge evaluator docs, configurable judge model/rubric/score scales, documented per-output scoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
